tool.name: Get VCFs from Sedna, a solution by Genovalia
tool.description: sample sheet (TSV) and VCFs of a Sedna dataset
tool.command: mkdir -p vcfs && python '$__tool_directory__/sedna_fetch.py' #if $token and str($token).strip() --token '$token' #end if --dataset-id '$dataset_id' --samples-out '$samples' --vcf-dir 'vcfs'

param.name: token
param.label: Keycloak token (Bearer)
param.help: Leave empty for a public dataset (identifiers only, no name). With a token: your own datasets, with their name. Expires quickly; it stays visible in the job's parameters.

tool.help: Without a token: public datasets only (samples and every available VCF). With a Keycloak token: access rights are those of your account. Every VCF of the dataset is downloaded, as a collection (one file per VCF, named after the assembly/name reported by Sedna).
